summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Dashboard features. Backend APIs 22/23 tests passed. One critical RBAC bug found - Authorization header not properly captured causing RBAC bypass. All UI features working correctly.

critical.issue: RBAC bypass - Authorization header not properly captured in FastAPI endpoint. When Authorization is sent as HTTP header (not query parameter), the 'authorization' parameter is None and RBAC check is bypassed. Front desk users can view all admin users.
critical.root_cause: The endpoint parameter 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' is treated as query parameter by FastAPI, not header. Need to use 'authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)' to capture HTTP headers.
affected_endpoints: All admin endpoints with authorization parameter

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix RBAC bypass in /api/admin/users and all admin endpoints - Change 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' to 'authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)' to properly capture HTTP Authorization headers
critical_code_review_comments: All admin endpoints use 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' which treats it as query parameter. FastAPI requires Header() annotation to capture HTTP headers.
Current code: 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' - reads from query params
Required fix: 'authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)' - reads from HTTP headers
seed_data_creation: Created test appointments and test_frontdesk_rbac user during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC bug requires backend code fix. After fix, verify that front_desk users get 403 when trying to access /api/admin/users. All other admin features (login, dashboard stats, appointments management, check-in, mark-served, reject card pickup, bulk reschedule, audit logs, user management) are working correctly.

mocked_apis.SendGrid: Email sending is mocked - no API key configured. Emails are logged but not sent.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: FastAPI endpoint parameter 'authorization: Optional[str] = None' is interpreted as query parameter, not HTTP header. Frontend sends 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' as HTTP header, but backend doesn't capture it since Header() annotation is missing.
rca_of_issue.evidence: curl with query param ?authorization=Bearer... returns 403 (correct), but curl with -H 'Authorization: Bearer...' returns 200 (bypass)
rca_of_issue.impact: Any authenticated user (including front_desk) can view and create admin users
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Add Header() annotation to authorization parameter in all admin endpoints: authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)
